summary: Practise IPC audits, surveillance and cluster response using WHO guidance. Explore the course and strengthen your care-setting action plans.
lede: Preventing infections in care settings combines risk assessment, surveillance, precautions and incident review. For IPC practitioners, clinical supervisors and quality officers, the course develops practical skills in auditing hand hygiene and PPE, summarising surveillance data, and investigating clusters. Participants also practise planning corrective actions and reporting progress using checklists, line lists and improvement records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess infection risks and coordinate preventive practice across clinical and care-delivery settings.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with clinical, care-delivery or healthcare quality workflows is helpful. No coding is required.
